decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the firm's market-data base, kept its own page in both years and thus appears to meet aspirations, and with slack in a growing industry there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The calculator was downgraded from its own page to a mention, which signals results below aspiration, but it sits close to the core tariff-data offer, so carrying it costs little and the firm's slack lets it stay for now.

The area definition tool lost its own page while sibling regional tools were already cut, which suggests a shortfall prompting problemistic search and consolidation of its resources into the central platform.
